svg.title: Off-axis collection behind a direct-beam stop — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: A real diffuser scatters a narrow 532 nm beam; a central beam dump excludes the direct direction while an offset photodetector collects a portion of the angular fan. The diffuser supplies a qualitative angular fan rather than particle-specific scattering. The setup demonstrates angular exclusion and collection, not a calibrated dark-field particle PSF.
